title: La mejenga
goal: Get picked for a game on the corner pitch
culture: A mejenga is a pick-up game and anybody can ask. These are the other people you address as VOS — kids, and now teammates. Pasámela is the vos imperative; pásamela with the accent early is Mexican television, and they will hear it.

beats.good: Just ask. Nobody is picking teams by ability and there is always room for one more.

beats.es: Dale pues. ¿De qué lado se pone?
beats.good: Dale is yes, go on, alright, get on with it. You will hear it forty times an hour in this district.
Pasámela, with the stress on the MA — that is the vos imperative and it is what they say. Pásamela, stressed early, is Mexican television and they will hear it instantly.
Buena esa is what you shout when somebody does something good, on a pitch or anywhere else. Two words, and it makes you one of them for the afternoon.
